correctness.rationale: Finite diagonal criterion proved via numerical-radius compression and positive-semidefinite row saturation. Infinite full-extremality follows because every two-coordinate compression of a decomposition agrees with U. The antiphase 2x2 block has w=1 exactly (rank-one nilpotent of norm 2). Unit-norm perturbations on increasingly almost-antipodal eigenpairs yield midpoint deficit δ/(1+δ) and distance 2/(1+δ). Upper bound 2 follows from triangle inequality. Exact quantifiers include every ε>0; finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The result pinpoints a genuine infinite-dimensional failure of an important finite-dimensional geometric compactness implication inside a canonical operator norm, using a natural normal unitary with pure-point spectrum. Full approximate-midpoint diameter 2 despite exact extremality is the strongest possible instability and exposes spectral accumulation as the mechanism; not a textbook corollary from a single finite-dimensional block.
